Built with Claude Code.

Campaign builds, audience segmentation, automated nurture and retention flows, multi-touch sequences, A/B split tests on subject lines and content, and open/click/delivery analytics reporting.

Recently built an internal content-operations hub that brings a US agency's work from 5 tools (Drive, ClickUp, Trello, GHL, Canva) into one app. In daily production. Also built the agency's in-house email/SMS platform (Cloudflare Workers + D1, React, Resend, Twilio), which is now replacing GoHighLevel, and integrated Square payments through the Square API on a Cloudflare-hosted client site.

## Selected Work

### My own AI builds (built with Claude Code; private, no public links)

- **AI video engine** — Turns a one-line topic into a finished 9:16 MP4 with burned captions, covers and ready-to-paste captions for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook Reels. Claude writes the script and topic ideas, OpenAI makes the images and voiceover, FFmpeg renders on my own PC (Python, FastAPI). Driven from Claude Code chat: cost estimate first, spends only after a go, never posts by itself. A real 2-part story cost $0.72 in API calls; 400+ unit tests plus acceptance suites.
- **Behind Works Platform** — My own platform on Hono + Cloudflare Workers + D1: contacts, pipeline, email campaigns, an Approvals queue (nothing sends without my yes; outreach capped at 10 a day), a job-application pipeline, and a Gmail bridge that sends approved applications from my own Gmail with my CV attached and reports replies back.
- **Job Tracker** — Google Apps Script + Gmail API: every 10 minutes, logs replies to my job applications to a Google Sheet, labels them and sends one alert; flags look-alike emails as unverified; reads only sender, subject and preview, on the smallest Gmail permission that allows labelling.

- **Arrow Platform** (in-house email & SMS marketing platform, built 2026) — Wrote the business case (projected ~89% lower monthly platform cost, no external build spend), then built it with AI-assisted development (Claude Code): TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Queues, React, Resend (email), Twilio (SMS). Agency view plus per-client dashboards, campaigns and reporting. 6 accounts went live about 5 weeks after the first commit (Aug–Sep 2026); 3,200+ automated tests. Safety built in: one-click unsubscribe, automatic opt-out on bounces and complaints, SMS blocked until A2P 10DLC approval, test mode by default. Now replacing GoHighLevel at the agency. Not publicly accessible — private company platform, no public link.
